name: Question 1
problem: Jordan wants to paint the outside of his home. Using $2$ gallons of paint, he was able to paint $450$ square feet of the surface. There is a proportional relationship between the volume of paint $x$ (in gallons) that Jordan uses and the area $y$ (in square feet) he paints. What is the equation that represents the relationship between $x$ and $y?$
